description: Bohemian escape in the heart of Paris! Nestled near the vibrant Marais, discover 70 m² of beach-summer atmosphere. Bright living room with orange notes, friendly table for six. Smart kitchen, discreet washing machine. Cozy master bedroom, ensuite bathroom. Connected TVs for your evenings (without subscription). Discover Paris, differently!The spaceYour bohemian and summer haven in the middle of ParisImmerse yourself in a 70 m² space in the heart of Paris, harmoniously combining the beach, bohemian and summer spirit. Every corner of this accommodation has been designed to offer you an unforgettable stay.Bright and spacious living room:Be greeted by a grandiose living room, where every color, every piece of furniture evokes escape. Orange hues recall the warmth of sunsets by the beach. Enjoy a friendly table that can accommodate up to six people for memorable dinners.Practical kitchen:Adjacent to the living room, discover a functional kitchen, ideal for Parisian stays. While it does not have an oven, it nevertheless offers everything you need for quick and easy meals. And for those who stay a little longer, a small vertical washing machine is at your disposal, although there is no dryer.Master bedroom:Find serenity and comfort in a spacious room equipped with a king-size bed (180 cm) and an additional single bed. The room has an en-suite bathroom with shower and toilet, guaranteeing considerable privacy.Guest room:Located near the entrance, this room consists of two separate single beds. It also has a desk for those who wish to work and well thought-out storage spaces.Entertainment:For your moments of relaxation, two connected and smart TVs offer you a range of applications such as Netflix and Amazon.
